<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">タトゥイーンを占領している場合、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、タトゥイーンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">タトゥイーンを占領している場合、ここにいる自分の宇宙船１隻につき、タトゥイーンの位置カード上での戦闘時で、合計戦力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-289o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine.

'''Light Side:''' If you occupy Tatooine, add 1 to total power in battles at Tatooine sites for each of your starships here.

'''Dark Side:''' If you occupy Tatooine, add 1 to total power in battles at Tatooine sites for each of your starships here.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses occupy; English uses control.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere)|Tatooine]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
